sources.title: East China Jiaotong University 2026 international English-taught program admissions brochure

requirements.ruleText: Hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least four years and document more than two years of actual residence abroad during the preceding four years up to April 30 of the admission year.
Provide TOEFL 80, IELTS 5.5, proof of prior education delivered entirely in English, or evidence that English is an official language.
Submit a bank-issued asset certificate for at least CNY 30,000 or equivalent foreign currency.

references.locator: Economic Capacity Requirement and Documents item 3

requirements.ruleText: Submit scans of the passport information page and the visa or residence-permit page when applicable.
Submit the highest diploma certificate and academic transcript.
Submit a valid medical examination report.
Submit a non-criminal-record certificate.
Submit the ECJTU application form and an electronic two-inch identification photo.
Submit a CV covering academic background and research output plus a study plan of at least 600 words.
Register in the official international-student application portal and submit the application materials online.
Attend the required online interview; schedule and format are announced in the application system.
The reviewed brochure states June 2026; the cycle is closed and no exact day is inferred.

sources.title: Wuchang University of Technology 2026 international undergraduate admission guide

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen with a valid foreign passport, be at least 18, in good health and conduct, and comply with Chinese law and university rules; applicants under 18 by August 31 must provide the required power of attorney.
Hold a high-school diploma or higher; current final-year students may submit an expected-graduation certificate and must obtain the diploma before enrollment.
Submit the passport information page and, when currently studying or working in China, the valid visa or residence permit.
Submit the highest academic certificate and complete high-school transcript; applicants with university study also submit completed university transcripts.
Submit a recent electronic passport-style photo.
Submit a relevant language certificate such as TOEFL, IELTS or HSK; the reviewed guide does not publish a minimum score.
Submit a physical-examination report issued by a recognized hospital.
Submit a non-criminal-record certificate issued by a public-security authority or the applicant's school.
Submit a bank deposit certificate under the applicant's or parents' name showing at least USD 4,000.
Submit the guardian guarantee letter.
Submit a one-to-three-minute English video containing a self-introduction and study plan.
Pay the CNY 500 application fee; the reviewed guide states its refund and tuition-offset conditions.
Pay the CNY 3,500 tuition prepayment before the JW202 form is released.
The reviewed 2026 guide does not state an application deadline; confirm it in the official application system.

references.locator: No deadline published in reviewed guide

sources.title: Tianjin University of Technology 2026-2027 international student admission brochure

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen who complies with the published nationality rules, has good conduct and health, and will follow Chinese law and university rules.
Hold a master's degree and be under age 40.
Submit a valid HSK Level 4 score report with at least 180.
Complete the official online application and upload the requested materials within the application period.
Apply from November 20, 2025 through May 31, 2026; the reviewed cycle is closed.
Pay the non-refundable CNY 400 application fee within the university-specified time after admission.
Participate in the university's comprehensive review of application materials and interview.
Bring the original highest academic credential, physical-examination record, blood-test report, HSK certificate and other original application materials for enrollment verification.
